Setup checklist

What to gather before a first site goes live. Seven items, in the order they matter.

  1. 01

    The equipment list

    Every machine with its model, serial number, location, department and criticality. It is the only thing genuinely required on day one — everything else attaches to it.

  2. 02

    The labelling plan

    Where the QR codes go, and who applies them. This is the physical part, the one that takes real time on the floor, and the one that makes reporting possible without an account.

  3. 03

    Parts and their minimums

    The items to track, their stores and locations, and a minimum level for each. The minimum is set from the supplier lead time, not from instinct.

  4. 04

    People and their roles

    Who is a manager, who is a technician, who is a requester. Operators reporting by QR code need no account, so they need no entry here.

  5. 05

    Existing preventive plans

    What is already done on a routine, and on what trigger: a date, a meter, or both. Bring them across as they are — the history will say later what should change.

  6. 06

    The files to migrate

    The spreadsheets and notebooks in use. We bring across the equipment and the parts; past history can stay archived rather than be retyped.

  7. 07

    Site settings

    Currency, timezone, date format and organisation language. The defaults are dirham, Africa/Casablanca, DD/MM/YYYY, French or English.

Setup is a one-off fee, quoted per site: we bring across your files, load the equipment and the parts, and train the team on site.
